name: sophos-central-mcp-server
description: Query and manage Sophos Fusion (formerly Sophos Central) from Claude. 300 tools across 21 API namespaces: endpoints, alerts, policies, firewalls, email, mobile, XDR, cases, SIEM, licensing, Fusion GraphQL cases, and more.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the Sophos Fusion (formerly Sophos Central) APIs so you can list and act on endpoints, alerts, policies, firewalls, email quarantine, mobile devices, XDR Data Lake queries, cases, SIEM feeds, licensing, audit events, and more from a chat. The `sophos_fusion_*` tools use the Sophos Fusion GraphQL APIs (Cases v2 today) beside the Sophos Central REST tools, on the same credential.

Works with tenant, partner, and organisation API credentials. Partner and organisation credentials unlock the cross-tenant tools (`sophos_list_tenants`, `sophos_list_account_health`, `sophos_partner_gap_analysis`) and every tenant-scoped tool then needs a `tenant_id`. Tenant credentials operate on that tenant only. Regional API hosts are discovered automatically.

Write actions carry `destructiveHint` annotations so clients can warn before isolating an endpoint, wiping a device, deleting a policy, and similar operations. The full tool list is in the project README.

sophos_client_id.title: Sophos Central Client ID
sophos_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID of a Sophos Central API credential. Create one in Sophos Central (Settings > API Credentials Management), the Sophos Partner Dashboard (Settings > API Credentials), or Sophos Central Enterprise (Global Settings > API Credentials Management).

sophos_client_secret.title: Sophos Central Client Secret
sophos_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret that pairs with the client ID above. Stored in your operating system's secure storage and passed to the server only as an environment variable.
